thesis: CROX is a high-quality, cheap, accelerating-earnings name in a confirmed uptrend (above SMA20/50/200) that has held its post-earnings re-rating for about three weeks and is making new highs. Fundamentals are solid (net income +48.65% YoY, ROE 49.1%, forward P/E 10.0, low dilution risk) and no scheduled event sits in the next 20 business days. The setup is a pullback entry at 155.5-159.0 with a stop at 148.8, giving about 2.6 reward/risk to a measured-move target of 178.9. This is a modest, conditional long, not a high-conviction one. The risk-off regime, extension above SMA20, rejection at 164.24 and a price at the mean analyst target all argue for a patient entry and small size.
